versions.changelog:
Initial release of lead-gen skill for B2B lead generation and qualification.

- Supports building targeted, qualified prospect lists for B2B sales.
- Guides users to define/refine ICP (industry, size, geography, title, pain point).
- Uses web search and enrichment tactics to identify decision-makers and contact data.
- Scores and prioritizes leads based on ICP fit, buying signals, and reachability.
- Outputs pipeline-ready, CSV-formatted lead lists with summary, scoring, and outreach suggestions.
